projection_authority.source: Workspace-scoped PostgreSQL Target, Graph, Artifact, Evidence, Verification, Submission, Review, Acceptance, ActionRequest, ActionApproval and EffectReceipt facts
projection_authority.stored_status_rule: A stored accepted label cannot produce an accepted read model; canceled is retained only as the explicit terminal override.
projection_authority.command_rule: availableCommands is advisory presentation data; every mutation keeps its command-side identity, scope and authority checks.

invalidation_proof: A new TargetRevision makes prior Submission, Review and Acceptance non-current.
A new ArtifactRevision makes the immutable Submission artifact binding stale.
A newer Submission makes an earlier Acceptance stale.
Failed or inconclusive current verification blocks accepted.
An executing action without receipt or unknown effect blocks accepted and emits Attention.

native_home_proof.fact_path: Target facts are projected directly into attentionService with sourceKind=target.
native_home_proof.legacy_independence: The dedicated test creates no Issue or Heartbeat and still observes the Target attention item.

timeline.scope: Target plus every subordinate native aggregate id
timeline.fallback: Unrecognized audited fact types remain visible as domain_event rather than being discarded.

database_guards: verrail_targets_status_check limits durable labels to the declared Target status vocabulary
existing composite Workspace foreign keys and immutable adjudication/content bindings remain authoritative

verification.result: 4,717 server and 4,440 UI tests passed; CLI e2e alone failed before server startup because isolated HOME triggered a blocked Corepack download
1 real-server CLI e2e passed after preserving the preinstalled COREPACK_HOME

residual_risks: The Graph Engine does not yet auto-complete human review or acceptance node types; T008 must present native adjudication commands without inventing UI completion state.

The full suite's only failure was an environment-dependent Corepack lookup in an isolated CLI test home; the corrected isolated test passed, and later closure verification must rerun the stable full suite.
